acceptance: The soundness path list includes the translation wrapper and its routing callers; tests/unit/scripts/test_soundness_paths.py pins each added path.
A PR touching any of them runs the medium tier and the oracle review (shown by a test or a dry-run of the path classifier).
The list change is merged with a current-head oracle success review.
context: 2026-10-21: superseded. #3192 makes oracle review fail closed (every non-inert PR is reviewed, the soundness list only sets strictness) and #3200/#3224 select or escalate PR tests by coverage, so adding these paths no longer changes whether the medium tier or review runs. Owner decides whether to drop.
description: PR 3185 changed benchbox/base.py and benchbox/utils/dialect_utils.py and its description said ClickBench results change, but .github/soundness-paths.txt lists neither file, so the PR's CI skipped the medium tier and oracle-review skipped its review. The break (tests/test_benchbox.py::test_translate_query, shard 1 of the medium tier) first appeared in the post-merge Trunk run 14 minutes later. Files whose output feeds published results must count as soundness paths: at least benchbox/utils/dialect_utils.py, benchbox/base.py, benchbox/platforms/base/dialect_translation.py and the vendored runtime consumers that translate SQL. Changing the list is itself a soundness-path change and needs oracle review.
